caption: The drawing depicts an ornate wrought iron railing panel consisting of an intricate pattern of scrollwork and acanthus leaves, executed in shades of gray and blue. The composition shows symmetrical, curving lines and stylized foliage, with a repeating pattern on either side of a vertical central divider. The top edge of the rail features pointed, flame-like shapes while the bottom rests on a stone base, rendered in muted gray tones. The overall design follows an elaborate, ornamental style with densely interwoven elements, some areas appearing more prominently shaded to convey depth and shadows, set against an off-white or beige background.
title: Iron Fence
